verdict.rationale: The California EDD is a government payroll-tax and unemployment-insurance agency. Its e-Services portal handles filings, payments, and account management. It is not an automation platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation capability. The ability to adjust returns or change payments is a different feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
